subject: general
question: Which of the following Union territories has the lowest population as per census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshadweep** has the lowest population among the Union territories of India as per the Census 2011.
 
• According to the Census 2011, Lakshadweep has a population of approximately **64,473**.
 
• The Union territories are smaller administrative units in India that are directly governed by the Central Government.
 
• The population data from the Census helps in planning and allocation of resources by the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census** is conducted every ten years by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• The Census provides comprehensive data on the demographic, social, and economic characteristics of the population.
 
• Other Union territories like **Dadra and Nagar Haveli**, **Daman and Diu**, and **Andaman and Nicobar** have higher populations compared to Lakshadweep.
 
• The Census data is crucial for the formulation of policies and programs aimed at the development and welfare of the population.
